blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Video generation has advanced rapidly, bringing synthetic videos closer to the visual quality of recorded footage [ 4 , 32 , 9 ] . Diffusion-based models can now generate photorealistic, temporally coherent videos from free-form text prompts [ 14 , 2 , 38 ] . They can depict complex camera movements and varied lighting conditions across a range of visual styles [ 38 ] . However, this visual quality does not ensure that a generated video accurately captures the content specified in a prompt [ 35 ] .
blocks.zh: 视频生成迅速进步,使合成视频更接近录制镜头的视觉质量[4,32,9]. 以传播为基础的模型现在可以从自由格式的文本提示中产生光现实性、时间性一致的视频[14、2、38]。 它们可以描绘各种视觉风格的复杂相机运动和各种照明条件[38]. 然而,这种视觉质量并不能确保生成的视频能准确捕捉到在即时[35]中指定的内容.

blocks.en: Current video generators rely on knowledge acquired during pretraining, limiting their ability to depict entities or events that emerged afterward. Even for familiar subjects, they can misrepresent a named technique or fail to preserve a person’s visual identity throughout a clip [ 46 ] . Generated motion may also violate basic physical laws, producing implausible behavior under gravity or during collisions [ 12 ] . Prompts that specify an ordered sequence of actions pose a further challenge, as models may omit phases or depict them out of order [ 37 ] . These limitations affect practical uses ranging from product demonstrations and educational content to sports analysis and film pre-visualization [ 25 ] . These challenges motivate the use of external knowledge and tools to guide video generation.
blocks.zh: 目前的视频生成者依赖于在预训期间获得的知识,限制了他们描绘之后出现的实体或事件的能力. 即使对熟悉的主体来说,他们也可以歪曲一种被命名的技术,或者无法在整个片断中保留一个人的视觉身份[46]. 产生的运动也可能违反基本的物理定律,在重力下或在碰撞期间产生不可信的行为[12]. 指定有秩序的行动顺序的提示构成进一步的挑战,因为模型可能忽略阶段,或者将阶段描述为不正常[37]。 这些局限性影响到从产品演示和教育内容到体育分析和电影预视等各种实际用途[25]. 这些挑战促使利用外部知识和工具指导视频制作。

blocks.en: Agentic video generation supplements video models with external tools and feedback, but existing approaches often target specific objectives [ 42 , 25 , 8 ] . Learning tool use across heterogeneous tasks requires an agent to select appropriate support, such as visual references for identity preservation or simulation for physical motion. It must also use intermediate observations to guide subsequent actions. This motivates multitask agentic reinforcement learning to optimize these decisions within a single agent using task-dependent feedback.
blocks.zh: 代理视频生成以外部工具和反馈补充视频模型,但现有方法往往针对具体目标[42,25,8]. 跨不同任务的学习工具使用需要代理人选择适当的支持,例如用于身份保存的视觉参考或用于物理运动的模拟. 它还必须利用中间观察来指导随后的行动。 这激发了多任务代理强化学习,利用任务依赖反馈,在单一代理内优化这些决策.

blocks.en: In this paper, we propose VideoGen-Agent , a multimodal agent trained through multitask agentic reinforcement learning to use external tools for video generation. It addresses six tasks: Procedural Knowledge, Single-Entity Identity, Multi-Entity Identity, Physics Simulation, Compositional Scene, and Multi-Shot. Across these tasks, the agent coordinates augmentation , generation , and verification tools based on the prompt and intermediate observations. Retrieval and simulation guide generation, while object detection [ 24 ] and depth estimation [ 43 ] provide feedback for refinement.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出VideoGen-Agent(VideoGen-Agent),通过多任务代理强化学习培训的多模式代理,使用外部工具制作视频. 它涉及六项任务:程序知识、单一实体身份、多实体身份、物理模拟、组成场景和多热。 在这些任务中,物剂根据即时和中间观测,协调增强、生成和核查工具。 检索和模拟引导生成,而物体检测[24]和深度估计[43]则提供反馈以供完善.

blocks.en: We train the agent across all six categories through supervised fine-tuning on teacher-distilled trajectories, followed by multitask agentic reinforcement learning. A hybrid reward evaluates tool use and generated video quality, while task advantage normalization balances learning signals across categories. A common tool interface also allows compatible tools to be upgraded without redesigning the agent’s workflows.
blocks.zh: 我们通过对教师疏导轨迹进行有监督的微调,然后进行多任务代理强化学习,对所有六类人员进行培训。 混合奖励评价工具的使用并产生视频质量,而任务正常化则平衡不同类别的学习信号. 一个共同的工具界面还可以在不重新设计代理工作流程的情况下对兼容的工具进行升级.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Overview of VideoGen-Agent. Given a user prompt, the multimodal agent reasons about the generation requirements and selects tools within a multi-turn reasoning–action–observation loop. Tool outputs inform subsequent decisions, allowing the agent to gather information, generate video candidates, and refine them. The toolbox contains three functional groups: augmentation , generation , and verification . Augmentation tools retrieve textual knowledge and visual references or simulate motion to guide generation. Generation tools support text-to-video, image-to-video, action-to-video, and motion-to-video generation. Here, image-to-video includes both single-image-to-video (I2V) and multiple-references(images)-to-video (R2V). Verification tools use object detection and depth estimation to assess subject presence and spatial structure, providing feedback for refinement. The agent returns the generated video when it finishes the interaction.

blocks.en: To evaluate VideoGen-Agent , we introduce VABench , a held-out benchmark of 600 prompts spanning the six capability categories described above. Each prompt emphasizes its target capability, enabling evaluation of distinct challenges in video generation. We assess generated videos using category-specific VLM rubrics and validate the judge’s agreement with human preferences.
blocks.zh: 为了评价VideoGen-Agent,我们引入了VA Bench, 即600个提示的搁置基准, 每个瞬间都强调其目标能力,从而能够评价录像制作中的不同挑战。 我们用特定类别的VLM标语来评估产生的视频,

blocks.en: On VABench, VideoGen-Agent improves its base T2V generator by 19.1 19.1 points, from 56.5 56.5 to 75.6 75.6 . Upgrading the generation tools further raises the score to 86.1 86.1 without additional agent training, achieving the highest scores across all six categories. Human raters prefer this configuration over the strongest standalone baseline in 84.3 % 84.3\% of comparisons. Ablations confirm the contributions of both training stages and reward components, supporting the benefits of learned tool use alongside stronger generation tools.
blocks.zh: 在VA Bench上,VideoGen-Agent将其基座T2V发电机改进了19.1 19.1分,从56.5 56.5分提高到75.6 75.6分. 不经过额外的代理训练,生成工具的升级进一步将分数提高到86.186.1,实现了所有六个类别中最高的分数. 在84.3%的比较中,人类评分者倾向于这种配置,而不是最强的独立基线。 拨款证实了培训阶段和奖励部分的贡献,支持在使用更强大的生成工具的同时使用已学到的工具的好处。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows: • We introduce VideoGen-Agent , a multimodal agent that learns to use external tools for video generation through multitask agentic reinforcement learning . SFT followed by multitask RL trains a shared policy to coordinate augmentation, generation, and verification tools. • We construct a tool-use trajectory dataset spanning six task categories and introduce VABench for held-out evaluation. The benchmark covers six capability categories that current single video generation models struggle with, including Procedural Knowledge, Single-Entity Identity, Multi-Entity Identity, Physics Simulation, Compositional Scene and Multi-Shot. • VideoGen-Agent improves the base T2V generator by approximately 19 19 points on VABench. Human evaluation supports these gains, while ablations demonstrate the contributions of SFT and RL with the generation tools held fixed.

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en:
In this section, we present the multitask agentic workflow and training procedure of VideoGen-Agent.
We first describe how the agent interacts with tools across six video-generation tasks, then detail supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning.
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们介绍VideoGen代理的多任务代理工作流程和培训程序。
我们首先描述代理人如何在6个视频生成任务中与工具互动,然后详细介绍监督的微调和强化学习.

blocks.en: 2.1 Multitask Agentic Workflow
blocks.zh: 2.1 多任务代理工作流程

blocks.en: Given a text prompt x x , VideoGen-Agent uses a shared multimodal policy to generate a video through multi-turn tool interactions. As illustrated in Figure 1 , each interaction follows a reasoning–action–observation loop. At step t t , the policy π θ \pi_{\theta} reasons over the history H t H_{t} , including the prompt, previous actions, and tool observations. It then selects a tool and specifies its arguments, incorporating the returned observation into the history for the next decision. This loop supports different generation workflows, allowing the agent to gather information, generate candidates, and verify or refine them as needed.
blocks.zh: 给文本提示 xx, 视频 Gen-Agent采用共同的多式联运政策,通过多回合工具交互生成视频. 如图1所示,每个相互作用都遵循推理-行动-观察循环。 包括及时、先前的行动和工具观察。 然后它选择一个工具并指定其论据,将返回的观察纳入历史,供下个决定. 这种循环支持不同的生成工作流程,使代理能够收集信息,生成候选人,并根据需要进行验证或完善.

blocks.en: 2.1.1 Tasks and Tools
blocks.zh: 2.1.1 任务和工具

blocks.en: Table 1 maps the six task categories to their default tool subsets and typical workflows. These workflows provide guidance for the shared policy, which specifies tool arguments and incorporates returned information according to each prompt.
blocks.zh: 表1将六个任务类别映射到它们的默认工具子集和典型的工作流程. 这些工作流程为共享政策提供了指导,该政策具体规定了工具参数,并按每个提示输入了返回的信息。

blocks.en: (a) Procedural Knowledge (PK) prompts describe specialized actions or processes whose accurate depiction requires detailed procedural knowledge. Text retrieval supplies relevant steps and motion details, which the agent incorporates into the generation prompt.
blocks.zh: (a) 程序知识(PK)提示说明其准确描述需要详细程序知识的专门行动或程序。 文本检索提供了相关的步骤和运动细节,代理人将这些步骤和细节纳入生成提示中。

blocks.en: (b) Single-Entity Identity (SI) and (c) Multi-Entity Identity (MI) require preserving the visual identity of one or more named subjects throughout a video. Subjects may include public landmarks, branded objects, game characters, celebrities, and so on. The agent searches visual references and passes selected images to an image conditioned or multi-references conditioned generator.
blocks.zh: (b) 单一实体身份(SI)和(c)多实体身份(MI)要求在整个视频中保留一个或多个被命名主体的视觉身份。 主题可能包括公共地标,品牌物品,游戏人物,名人等. 代理搜索可视化引用,并将选定的图像传递到一个有图像条件或多参考条件的生成器.

blocks.en: (d) Physics Simulation (PS) prompts specify physical motion under given initial conditions, including collisions, free fall, and celestial-body motion. The agent invokes simulation tools to obtain motion conditions and passes them to a motion-conditioned generator.
blocks.zh: (d) 物理模拟(PS)提示规定在特定初始条件下的物理运动,包括碰撞、自由坠落和天体运动。 该剂使用模拟工具来获取运动条件,并将其传递给具有运动条件的发电机.

blocks.en: (e) Compositional Scene (CS) tests multi-subject composition, inter-object interactions, and spatial relations. Prompts use visually canonical subjects to emphasize scene structure rather than identity. The agent generates a candidate, checks it with verification tools, and uses the feedback to guide regeneration when necessary.
blocks.zh: (e) 组成场景(CS)测试多主体组成、物体间相互作用和空间关系。 提示使用视觉卡通对象来强调场景结构而不是身份. 代理生成一个候选,用核查工具检查,并在必要时利用反馈指导再生.

blocks.en:
(f) Multi-Shot (MS) tests whether a video depicts all requested phases in the correct temporal order.
These prompts also use visually canonical subjects, allowing evaluation to focus on temporal structure. The agent generates the phases sequentially, using the final frame of each segment to condition the next and maintain visual continuity.
blocks.zh:
(f) 多镜头(MS)测试视频是否按照正确的时间顺序描绘所有要求的阶段。
这些提示还使用视觉卡通主题,使得评价能够专注于时间结构. 该剂依次生成相位,利用每个段的最后帧来对下段进行条件化并保持视觉连续性.

blocks.en: All tools are accessed through a common interface, allowing compatible backend implementations to be used within the same workflows. Table 5 in Appendix A.2 lists the models and services used during training.
blocks.zh: 所有工具都通过共同的接口访问,允许兼容的后端执行在同一工作流程内使用. 附录A.2的表5列出了培训中使用的模式和服务。

blocks.en: Figure 2 : Overview of the training pipeline for VideoGen-Agent. We construct prompts across six task categories and collect teacher-generated tool-use trajectories for supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Starting from the SFT checkpoint, the agent generates new rollouts on a separate prompt set for multitask reinforcement learning with GRPO. A hybrid reward evaluates tool-call validity, task-appropriate tool use, and generated video quality. Task advantage normalization follows group-relative normalization to balance learning signals across categories.
blocks.zh: 图2:VideoGen-Agent培训管道概况. 我们构建了6个任务类别的提示,并收集教师生成的工具使用轨迹,用于监督微调。 从SFT检查点开始,代理在单独的快速集上生成新的推出,用于与GRPO进行多任务强化学习. 混合奖励评价工具调用的有效性,适合任务的工具使用,并产生视频质量. 任务优势正常化遵循集团相对正常化,以平衡各类学习信号.

blocks.en: 2.2 Data Construction
blocks.zh: 2.2 国家 数据构建

blocks.en: High-quality training data is essential for an agent that must learn to compose specialized tools into a generation pipeline. However, no public dataset directly aligns prompts with the category labels, agentic trajectories, and reference assets needed for tool-grounded video generation. To address this, we carefully curate a challenging training dataset.
blocks.zh: 高质量的培训数据对于必须学会将专门工具编成一代人管道的代理人至关重要。 然而,没有公共数据集直接将提示与分类标签,代理轨迹,以及基于工具的视频生成所需的参考资产对齐. 为了解决这一问题,我们仔细整理了一个具有挑战性的培训数据集。

blocks.en: We use Claude Opus 4.7 to generate training prompts in batches for each of the six task categories. We supplement these prompts with examples drawn from public datasets, either directly or with minor modifications. Following the task definitions in Section 2.1.1 , we simplify non-target aspects of each prompt so that the intended capability remains the primary challenge. For Procedural Knowledge and Physics Simulation , we use simple subjects and backgrounds to focus on procedural accuracy and physical dynamics, respectively. For Single-Entity Identity and Multi-Entity Identity , we pair named subjects with simple actions or processes to focus on identity preservation. For Compositional Scene and Multi-Shot , both subjects and individual actions are simple, concentrating the challenge on spatial composition and temporal ordering, respectively. Each Multi-Shot prompt specifies two to four ordered phases to support learning sequential generation workflows.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Claude Opus 4.7为六个任务类别中的每一个类别分批生成培训提示。 我们用从公共数据集中摘取的例子来补充这些提示,或者直接或略作修改。 遵照第2.1.1节中的任务定义,我们简化了每个提示的非目标方面,以便预期的能力仍然是主要挑战。 关于程序知识和物理模拟,我们使用简单的科目和背景,分别侧重于程序准确性和物理动态。 对于单一实体身份和多实体身份,我们用简单的动作或过程将命名对象组合在一起,专注于身份保护。 对于组成场景和多场景,主题和个人动作都很简单,分别将挑战集中在空间组成和时间顺序上. 每个多热速率指定两到四个顺序阶段,以支持学习顺序生成工作流程.

blocks.en: For each constructed prompt, we randomly select Gemini 3.1 Pro or Claude Opus 4.7 as the teacher agent to generate a tool-use trajectory. Both teachers use the same high-level tool interfaces as VideoGen-Agent and follow the system prompt in Appendix A.3 . Each teacher uses textual and visual observations to select relevant evidence and construct inputs for subsequent generation calls. We record the complete interaction history, including the teacher’s reasoning, tool calls, returned observations, and final generated video. This process yields 24K agent trajectories, of which 16K teacher trajectories are used for SFT. The remaining 8K prompts are reserved for RL, during which the policy generates new trajectories for reward-based optimization.
blocks.zh: 对于每一个构建的快速,我们随机选择双子座3.1 Pro或克劳德·奥普斯4.7作为教师代理,生成一个工具使用轨迹. 两位教师使用与VideoGen-Agent相同的高级工具界面,并遵循附录A.3中的系统提示. 每个教师使用文字和视觉观察来选择相关证据,并为后一代的呼叫构建投入. 我们记录完整的互动历史,包括老师的推理、工具呼叫、返回的观察以及最后产生的视频。 这个过程产生24K代理轨迹,其中16K师范轨迹用于SFT. 其余的8K提示为RL预留,期间政策为奖励优化产生新的轨迹.

blocks.en: 2.3 Stage 1: Supervised Fine-Tuning
blocks.zh: 2.3 第一阶段:监督精细

blocks.en: We fine-tune the shared agent policy π θ \pi_{\theta} on the 16K teacher trajectories described in Section 2.2 using a standard next-token prediction objective. We use the same system prompt as the teacher agents, provided in Appendix A.3 , which specifies the available tools and workflow guidance. Failed action spans are masked from the loss but retained in the interaction context together with their error observations. The remaining valid steps, including subsequent recovery actions, continue to provide supervision. We denote the resulting agent policy by π θ 0 \pi_{\theta_{0}} and use it to initialize reinforcement learning.
2.4 Stage 2: Agentic RL
blocks.zh: 2.4 第2阶段:代理RL

blocks.en:
Starting from π θ 0 \pi_{\theta_{0}} , we optimize the agent policy using Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) [ 33 ] . For each training prompt x x from category c c , the behavior policy π θ old \pi_{\theta_{\mathrm{old}}} samples n n rollout trajectories { τ i } i = 1 n \{\tau_{i}\}_{i=1}^{n} .
Each trajectory contains multi-turn tool calls, returned observations, and a final generated video.
Only agent-emitted tokens contribute to the policy objective; tool-response tokens serve as context and are masked from the loss.
External tool errors are returned as textual observations to allow recovery attempts.
Trajectories that ultimately fail because of these errors are excluded from optimization.

blocks.en: 3.1 Implementation Details
blocks.zh: 3.1 执行细节

blocks.en: We use Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct [ 1 ] as the base agent policy for all agent variants. For SFT, we train on 16K tool-use trajectories with AdamW [ 26 ] at a learning rate of 5 × 10 − 5 5\times 10^{-5} for two epochs. Training uses eight H200 141GB GPUs with FSDP [ 49 ] . For RL, we initialize from the SFT checkpoint and train with GRPO for one epoch on the remaining 8K prompts. Each batch contains eight prompts, with n = 6 n=6 rollouts sampled per prompt. We set ϵ lo = 0.2 \epsilon_{\mathrm{lo}}=0.2 , ϵ hi = 0.28 \epsilon_{\mathrm{hi}}=0.28 , and β KL = 10 − 3 \beta_{\mathrm{KL}}=10^{-3} . Only agent-generated tokens contribute to the RL objective; tool responses are retained as context. Rollouts that ultimately fail because of external tool errors are excluded from optimization. RL uses eight H200 GPUs for agent policy training and another eight for serving generation and verification tools.

RL使用8个H200GPU进行代理政策培训,另外8个用于服务生成和核查工具.

blocks.en: We select generation tools to balance support for different conditioning inputs, generation speed, and generation quality. Since no single model met all these requirements in our setup, we use separate tools for T2V, I2V, R2V, and M2V. We configure two complete toolsets, each containing augmentation, generation, and verification tools. Toolset 1 is used throughout training. Toolset 2 upgrades all generation tools while retaining the same augmentation and verification tools. The upgraded tools provide the same functions but may use larger models or slower sampling to improve generation quality. At evaluation, we test the same trained agent policy with both toolsets, without additional training. This comparison measures the benefit of using upgraded generation tools that the agent did not encounter during training. The toolset configurations are detailed in Appendix A.2 .
blocks.zh: 我们选择生成工具来平衡对不同条件输入,生成速度和生成质量的支持. 由于没有单一的型号在我们的设置中满足了所有这些要求,我们分别使用工具用于T2V,I2V,R2V和M2V. 我们配置两个完整的工具箱,每个工具都包含增强、生成和核查工具。 工具集1用于整个培训。 工具集2对所有生成工具进行升级,同时保留相同的增强和验证工具. 升级后的工具提供相同的功能,但可能使用更大的模型或较慢的采样来提高生成质量. 在评估时,我们用两种工具测试同样的训练有素的代理政策,而不进行额外培训。 这种比较衡量了使用代理人在培训期间没有遇到的升级生成工具的好处。 工具箱配置详见附录A.2。

blocks.en: VABench. We evaluate on VABench, a held-out benchmark of 600 prompts, with 100 prompts per task category. Human reviewers check each prompt for suitability for visual depiction and an appropriate level of difficulty within its category. We use Gemini 3.1 Pro to evaluate generated videos with the same reward system prompts and category-specific scoring weights used during training. We normalize per-video scores to [ 0,100 ] [0,100] and report the mean for each category. Details of benchmark construction and evaluation are provided in Appendix A .
blocks.zh: VA奔驰. 我们评价的是VA Bench, 一个600个提示的基准,每个任务类别100个提示。 人文审查员检查每个提示是否适合视觉描绘,并检查其类别内是否有适当的难度。 我们使用双子座3.1 Pro来评价生成的视频 同样的奖励系统提示 和特定类别的评分权重 在训练中使用。 我们把每个视频的分数正常化到[0,100][0,100],并报告每个类别的平均值。 基准建设和评价的详情见附录A。

blocks.en: Baselines. We compare VideoGen-Agent against open-source and proprietary text-to-video models used in a single-pass setting. Open-source baselines include CogVideoX-5B [ 44 ] , Mochi-1 [ 10 ] , HunyuanVideo-13B [ 19 ] , and Wan2.1-T2V-14B [ 38 ] . Proprietary baselines include Hailuo 2.0 [ 27 ] , Kling 3.0 [ 18 ] , Seedance 1.0 Pro Fast [ 9 ] , and Seedance 2.0 Fast [ 32 ] . We evaluate VideoGen-Agent with both toolsets against these standalone generators.
blocks.zh: 基线。 我们比较了VideoGen-Agent和在单通道设置中使用的开源和专有文本对视频模型. 开源基线包括CogVideoX-5B[44],Mochi-1[10],HunyuanVideo-13B[19],以及Wan2.1-T2V-14B[38]. 专有基线包括海路2.0 [27],Kling 3.0 [18],种子1.0 Pro Fast [9],种子2.0 Fast [32]. 我们用两个工具来评估VideoGen-Agent 与这些独立的发电机。

blocks.en: Ablation Study. We compare the vanilla T2V generator, prompt rewriting, zero-shot tool use, SFT, and RL under the Toolset 1 configuration. The vanilla and prompt-rewriting baselines use the same T2V generator as the agentic variants. For zero-shot tool use, we provide Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct with the tools and interfaces in Toolset 1 and the agent system prompt, without additional training. We then compare this agent with VideoGen-Agent-SFT and the full RL-trained agent, keeping the toolset fixed to assess the contribution of each training stage.
blocks.zh: 校勘研究. 我们比较了"工具1"配置下的香草T2V生成器,即时重写,零镜头工具使用,SFT,以及RL. 香草和即时重写基线使用相同的T2V生成器作为剂变体. 对于零镜头工具的使用,我们为Qune3-VL-8B-Instruct提供了Tolket 1中的工具和接口以及代理系统即时,而无需额外的训练. 然后,我们将这个代理与VideoGen-Agent-SFT和全RL训练的代理进行对比,保留固定的工具盘以评估每个培训阶段的贡献.

With Toolset 1, VideoGen-Agent achieves an overall score of 75.6 75.6 , improving on its base T2V generator, Seedance 1.0, by 19.1 19.1 points. It also exceeds Seedance 2.0, the strongest standalone baseline overall, by 2.4 2.4 points, although it remains below this model on Multi-Entity Identity and Compositional Scene. With Toolset 2, VideoGen-Agent reaches 86.1 86.1 overall and achieves the highest score in every category.

blocks.en: Generation Tool Upgrades. Replacing the generation tools in Toolset 1 with those in Toolset 2 raises the overall score from 75.6 75.6 to 86.1 86.1 . The agent policy remains fixed, and the augmentation and verification tools are unchanged. Scores improve in all six categories, with the largest increase on Multi-Entity Identity, from 65.3 65.3 to 86.7 86.7 . These results show that the trained agent can benefit from compatible generation tools not encountered during training, without additional policy optimization.

blocks.en: Per-category Analysis. The category-level results show where tool-augmented generation provides the largest gains. Relative to Seedance 2.0, VideoGen-Agent-Toolset 2 improves Procedural Knowledge by 14.1 14.1 points, Multi-Entity Identity by 17.7 17.7 points, and Multi-Shot by 25.7 25.7 points. These categories require detailed procedural knowledge, multiple visual references, or explicit temporal structure, which their respective workflows supply through retrieval and sequential generation. Gains on Single-Entity Identity and Physics Simulation are 8.2 8.2 and 9.0 9.0 points, respectively, consistent with the use of visual references and simulated motion. The improvement on Compositional Scene is smaller at 2.9 2.9 points, with the strongest standalone baseline already scoring 87.8 87.8 . This variation indicates that the benefit of tool augmentation depends on the capability required by the prompt.
blocks.zh: 按类别分析。 类别层面的结果表明,工具强化生成提供了最大的收益。 相对于种子2.0, VideoGen-Agent-Toolset 2 改进了 程序知识14.1 14.1分,多实体身份17.7 17.7分,多Shot25.7分. 这些类别需要详细的程序知识、多种视觉参考或明确的时间结构,它们各自的工作流程通过检索和顺序生成提供。 单实体身份和物理模拟的增益分别为8.2 8.2和9.0 9.0分,与使用视觉参考和模拟运动一致. 组成场景的改善在2.9分时较小,最强的独立基线已经得分87.887.8。 这一变化表明,工具增强的好处取决于迅速增强所需的能力。

blocks.en: Case Study. Figures 3 – 8 show how tool use improves generation in each task category. For PK, only the two VideoGen-Agent variants using Seedance 1.0 and 2.0 closely reproduce the characteristic details of “White Crane Spreads Its Wings.” Both largely capture the movement, although the empty stance, with weight mainly on the rear leg and the front foot lightly touching the ground, remains imperfect. The Seedance 1.0 variant instead produces a horse stance despite the correct stance being specified in its generation prompt, indicating a remaining generator limitation. For SI and MI, only the VideoGen-Agent variants reproduce the correct characters and actions, using correctly retrieved character images as references. For PS, only VideoGen-Agent with Wan-VACE-14B captures the specified speed, collision, post-impact velocity relationships, and induced rotation. The agent supplies the appropriate simulation function and parameters to produce motion guidance consistent with the physical scenario. For CS, only VideoGen-Agent satisfies the full prompt in the illustrated complex scene. Detection feedback guides prompt revision and regeneration, helping the generator depict the required subjects and their temporally ordered interactions. For MS, only VideoGen-Agent produces shots matching the prompt’s temporal structure by dividing the sequence into separately generated segments and concatenating them in order.
blocks.zh: 个案研究。 图3-8显示工具的使用如何改善每个任务类别的生成。 对于PK,只有使用种子1.0和2.0的两个VideoGen-Agent变体紧密地复制了“白鹤散开它的翅膀”的特征细节。 两者基本上都抓住了运动,虽然空姿势仍然不完善,主要重在后腿和前脚轻轻触地. 种子1.0变体反而产生了马姿势,尽管其生成的瞬间规定了正确的姿势,表明仍然存在发电机限制。 对于SI和MI,只有VideoGen-Agent变体复制正确的字符和动作,使用正确检索的字符图像作为参考. 仅用于 PS 视频 Gen-Agent with Wan-VACE-14B 捕获指定的速度,碰撞,撞击后速度关系,以及诱导旋转. 该剂提供了适当的模拟功能和参数,以产生符合物理情景的运动向导. CS 仅限视频 Gen-Agent满足了被描绘的复杂场景中的全部提示. 检测反馈指导着快速修正和再生,帮助生成者描绘所需对象及其按时间顺序排列的相互作用. 对于MS, 仅是视频 Gen-Agent通过将序列分割为单独生成的片段,并按顺序对片段进行整齐,从而产生匹配导电符时间结构的镜头.

blocks.en: Human Preference. We conduct a side-by-side evaluation on 100 randomly sampled video pairs from VABench, comparing VideoGen-Agent-Toolset 2 with Seedance 2.0. Four human raters evaluate each pair, with an overall preference rate of 84.3 % 84.3\% for VideoGen-Agent-Toolset 2 across their ratings. The largest preference margins occur on Procedural Knowledge and Multi-Shot, supporting the automatic evaluation results for procedural accuracy and temporal structure.

Prompt rewriting raises the overall score from 56.5 56.5 to 57.3 57.3 , while zero-shot tool use reaches 59.5 59.5 . These modest gains suggest that prompt elaboration and tool access alone do not account for the full improvement. Despite workflow guidance, the zero-shot agent frequently fails to invoke tools correctly. SFT raises the score to 69.2 69.2 , and RL improves another 6.4 6.4 points to reach 75.6 75.6 with the toolset unchanged. Both stages improve every category, supporting the contributions of trajectory supervision and reward-based optimization.

Both ablations reduce performance across all six categories, with the larger drop from removing the tool reward highlighting its contribution. We also compare the shared multitask agent with agents trained separately for each task. Single-task RL achieves 76.3 76.3 overall, exceeding multitask RL by 0.7 0.7 points, with higher scores on Procedural Knowledge, Multi-Entity Identity, and Compositional Scene. Multitask RL performs better on the remaining categories, supporting all six tasks with one agent while achieving a similar overall score.

blocks.en: We explore whether VideoGen-Agent can incorporate additional tools through an action-to-video pipeline for robotic manipulation. Midway through training, we introduce examples containing an input image and a textual instruction. The agent invokes π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} [ 30 ] to predict actions, then passes them to Ctrl-World [ 13 ] for video generation. The resulting videos more closely match the ground truth than direct I2V generation, supporting the framework’s extensibility through continued training.
blocks.zh: 我们探索VideoGen-Agent是否能够通过一个用于机器人操纵的从动作到视频的管道纳入更多的工具. 通过培训,我们引入了包含输入图像和文字指导的例子。 代理机引用 \ 0. 5\ pi\ 0. 5} [ 30] 预测动作, 然后传递到 Ctrl-World [ 13] 用于视频生成. 所产生的录像比直接的I2V生成更贴近地面真相,通过继续培训支持框架的延伸。

blocks.en: We further evaluate unseen task combinations that were not included during training, such as a named character performing a specialized action. These prompts combine the procedural knowledge required by Procedural Knowledge with the identity constraints of Single-Entity Identity. The agent invokes both text and image retrieval, combining procedural guidance with visual references to support generation. This behavior suggests that its learned tool-use strategies generalize to unseen combinations of requirements beyond the default training workflows.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步评价培训期间未包括的隐形任务组合,例如执行专门行动的指定角色。 这些提示将程序知识所要求的程序知识与单一实体身份的限制结合起来。 代理机同时引用文本和图像检索,将程序指导与视觉参考结合起来支持生成. 这种行为表明其学习到的工具使用策略一般化为默认训练工作流程以外的隐形组合要求.

blocks.en: 4 Related Work
blocks.zh: 4 相关工作

blocks.en: Video generation has advanced through diffusion-based models [ 14 , 2 , 31 , 38 , 44 ] and autoregressive approaches that generate visual sequences incrementally [ 45 , 40 ] . Despite improvements in visual quality, depicting specific entities, physical interactions, and ordered events remains challenging. To address these limitations, recent systems augment generators with external planning and control. Scene decomposition and editing pipelines organize generation into smaller steps [ 36 , 15 , 28 ] , while physics-guided methods use simulation or force-based controls to guide motion [ 47 , 8 , 20 ] . These approaches illustrate how specialized workflows can support requirements that are difficult to satisfy through prompting alone. Our work builds on these capabilities by training a shared agent policy to use different tools across multiple generation tasks.
blocks.zh: 视频生成通过基于传播的模型[14,2,31,38,44]和渐进生成视觉序列的自递式方法[45,40]得到了推进. 尽管视觉质量有所改善,描绘具体实体、物理互动和有秩序的事件仍然具有挑战性。 为解决这些局限性,最近的系统通过外部规划和控制来增强发电机。 场景分解和编辑管道将生成组织成较小的步骤[36,15,28],而物理制导方法则使用模拟或武力控制来引导运动[47,8,20]. 这些方法说明专门的工作流程如何能够支持单靠催促就难以满足的要求。 我们的工作以这些能力为基础,培训共同代理政策,在多代任务中使用不同的工具。

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards improves multi-step reasoning by optimizing models against task outcomes [ 11 , 33 ] . Agentic RL extends this approach to trajectories that interleave reasoning with external tool calls. Search-R1 [ 17 ] , R1-Searcher [ 34 ] , and ReSearch [ 5 ] train agents to retrieve information during reasoning. DeepResearcher [ 50 ] and WebDancer [ 41 ] study extended information-seeking workflows, while ToRL [ 21 ] incorporates code execution. Related multimodal research develops visual understanding [ 23 , 39 ] , GUI interaction [ 6 , 22 ] , and embodied control [ 16 , 3 ] . These settings primarily concern answering questions or completing actions. Video generation requires evaluating the produced visual content as well as the tool-use decisions that lead to it.
blocks.zh: 以可核查的奖励加强学习,通过对照任务结果优化模式,改进多步骤推理[11,33]. Agentic RL将这种方法扩展至将推理与外部工具调用交互的轨迹. 搜索-R1 [17],R1-Searcher [34],ReSearch [5] 列车代理在推理时检索信息. 深度研究者[50]和WebDancer[41]研究扩展信息搜索工作流程,而TORL[21]则包含代码执行. 相关的多式联运研究发展了视觉理解[23,39],GUI相互作用[6,22],并体现了控制[16,3]. 这些环境主要涉及回答问题或完成行动。 视频制作需要评估制作的视觉内容以及导致视频制作的工具使用决定。

blocks.en: Agentic image generation uses external information to ground visual synthesis, as illustrated by the “research-then-generate” approach [ 29 ] . Gen-Searcher [ 7 ] trains a search-augmented image-generation agent through SFT followed by GRPO, using a joint text–image reward. This establishes a connection between learned tool use and visual generation, but focuses on image synthesis with search augmentation. For video, VISTA [ 25 ] performs test-time refinement through iterative generation, multimodal critique, and prompt revision. VideoGen-Agent instead trains an agent policy across six video-generation tasks, using workflow guidance to coordinate retrieval, simulation, generation, and verification. Its multitask hybrid reward evaluates tool-call validity and task-appropriate tool use alongside category-specific video quality.
blocks.zh: 代理图像生成利用外部信息进行地面视觉合成,如“研究-当时的遗传”方法[29]所示。 Gen-Searcher [7] 通过SFT培训一个搜索增强的图像生成代理,之后是GRPO,使用联合文本-图像奖励. 这建立了学习工具的使用和视觉生成之间的联系,但专注于带有搜索增强的图像合成. 就视频而言,VISTA[25]通过迭代生成、多式联运批评和迅速修订来进行测试时间的改进。 视频 Gen-Agent则在六个视频生成任务中培训代理政策,利用工作流程指导来协调检索、模拟、生成和核查。 它的多任务混合奖励评价了工具调用的有效性和与特定类别视频质量同时使用的适合任务的工具.

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: We introduced VideoGen-Agent , a multimodal agent that learns to use external tools across diverse video-generation tasks. SFT followed by multitask RL trains a shared agent policy to coordinate augmentation, generation, and verification tools. We also constructed a category-balanced training dataset and VABench, a held-out benchmark covering six generation capabilities. Experiments show gains over standalone video generators, with ablations supporting the contributions of both training stages. Upgrading the generation tools further improves performance without additional agent training, demonstrating complementary benefits from learned tool use and advances in generation models.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了VideoGen-Agent, 一种多模式代理, SFT之后是多任务RL培训共享代理政策,以协调增强、生成和核查工具。 我们还建立了一个类别平衡的培训数据集和VA Bench,这是一个涵盖6个发电能力的搁置基准。 实验显示,相对于独立的视频发电机而言,有增益,同时,模拟事件支持两个培训阶段的贡献。 升级生成工具在不进行额外的代理培训的情况下进一步提高了性能,证明了学习工具的使用和生成模型的进步所带来的互补效益.

blocks.en: 6 Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 6 限制和今后的工作

blocks.en: VideoGen-Agent is currently limited by the quality and latency of its generation tools, the coverage of its verification feedback, and its six-task training setting. These limitations motivate improvements in both agent training and the tools available to the agent. Future work could explore training methods such as on-policy distillation to provide supervision on the agent’s own trajectories and improve decisions across tasks. Stronger video-understanding models could provide more detailed feedback on generated content, helping the agent identify errors and make targeted corrections. Faster, higher-quality generation tools that are easier to deploy could reduce interaction costs and make iterative refinement more practical. Beyond individual components, jointly improving agent training, video feedback, and generation tools could support more complex workflows and a broader range of creative tasks. We hope VideoGen-Agent provides a foundation for studying these advances together and developing video-generation agents that improve as their training methods and tools evolve.
blocks.zh: 视频 gen-Agent目前受到以下因素的限制:其生成工具的质量和耐用性、其核查反馈的覆盖面以及其6个任务的培训设置。 这些限制促使改进代理人培训和代理人可利用的工具。 今后的工作可以探讨培训方法,例如政策提炼,以监督代理人自己的轨迹,改进各项任务的决定。 更强大的视频理解模型可以对生成的内容提供更详尽的反馈,帮助代理识别错误并作出有针对性的更正. 更快、质量更高的生成工具更便于使用,可以降低互动成本,使迭代完善更切合实际。 除了各个组成部分外,联合改进代理培训、视频反馈和生成工具,可以支持更复杂的工作流程和更广泛的创造性任务。 我们希望VideoGen-Agent为共同研究这些进步和发展随着培训方法和工具的发展而改进的视频生成代理提供基础.

blocks.en: We use Gemini 3.1 Pro to score generated videos against category-specific rubrics. The judge receives the user prompt, optional textual or image references, and the generated video, then returns per-dimension scores in JSON format. All categories share a common prompt structure, with different evaluation criteria, scoring scales, and category-specific instructions.

Integer scores are divided by 10 10 , while discrete scores are used directly.

blocks.en: Some prompts specify a total video duration and assign actions to explicit time intervals, such as three phases within a 12-second video. Before generation, we check whether the requested duration is supported by the selected generation tool. If necessary, we adjust the duration and corresponding timestamps in the generation prompt so that each generated segment uses a supported length. This adjustment preserves the requested events and their temporal order. Evaluation uses the adjusted timing requirements, so models are not penalized solely for unsupported output durations.
blocks.zh: 一些提示指定了视频的总持续时间,并指定了明确的时间间隔的行动,如12秒的视频中的三个阶段. 在生成前,我们检查请求的持续时间是否由选定的生成工具支持. 如有必要,我们会在生成提示中调整持续时间和相应的时间戳,以便每个生成的段使用一个支持的长度. 这一调整保留了请求的事件及其时间顺序. 评价采用调整后的时间安排要求,因此模型不会仅仅因为没有支持的产出期限而受到处罚.

blocks.en: For Physics Simulation, the VLM assesses the plausibility of the depicted physical interactions, including contact, rebound, motion direction, and induced rotation. It does not verify exact masses, velocities, or accelerations from appearance alone. The simulation system prompt specifies the spatial window and coordinate conventions used to construct motion conditions (Appendix A.3 ). Separate tracking and numerical analysis code provides quantitative checks of measurable motion. These checks contribute 0.20 0.20 to the total score, as reported in Table 6 , while physical plausibility remains the primary criterion.
blocks.zh: 对于物理模拟,VLM评估所描绘的物理相互作用的可信度,包括接触,反弹,运动方向,以及诱导旋转. 它不核实 准确的质量,速度, 或加速 从外观。 模拟系统即时指定用于构建运动条件的空间窗口和协调常规(附录A.3)。 单独的跟踪和数字分析代码对可衡量的运动提供了定量检查. 如表6所示,这些检查使总分达到0.20.0,而物理可信度仍然是首要标准。

blocks.en: Figures 3 – 8 present qualitative comparisons between VideoGen-Agent and standalone video generators across all six task categories in VABench. Each figure shows uniformly sampled frames from videos generated for the same prompt, highlighting differences in how the methods satisfy its requirements. Together, these examples illustrate how retrieval, simulation, verification, and sequential generation support procedural accuracy, identity preservation, physical consistency, scene composition, and temporal ordering.
blocks.zh: 图3 - 8列出了VideoGen-Agent与VA Bench所有六个任务类别的独立视频生成器之间的定性比较。 每个图都显示从为同一快件生成的视频中统一取样的帧,突出显示方法如何满足其要求的不同. 这些例子共同说明检索、模拟、核查和顺序生成如何支持程序准确性、身份保存、物理一致性、场景组成和时间顺序。

blocks.en: Figure 3 : Qualitative comparison on Procedural Knowledge generation. The prompt asks a practitioner to perform the “White Crane Spreads Its Wings” Tai Chi movement in a calm open space. Each row shows six uniformly sampled frames from a video generated by a baseline model or VideoGen-Agent. Retrieved procedural descriptions help VideoGen-Agent reproduce the characteristic arm positions and movement progression more accurately than the standalone generators. Stance errors remain: the Seedance 1.0 variant produces a horse stance despite receiving a generation prompt specifying the correct empty stance.
blocks.zh: 图3:程序知识生成的质量比较。 该提示请一名执业者在平静的空地上进行“白鹤展翅”太极运动。 每行显示基线模型或VideoGen-Agent生成的视频中六个统一取样的帧. Retrieved 程序描述帮助 VideoGen-Agent 复制特征臂姿势,运动进展比独立发电机更准确. Stance 错误依然存在:种子1.0变体尽管收到一代人提示正确的空姿势的提示,却会产生马姿势.

blocks.en: Figure 4 : Qualitative comparison on Single-Entity Identity generation. The prompt depicts Camellya from Wuthering Waves performing a crimson rose-thorn whip attack, with petals accompanying the strike. Each row shows six uniformly sampled frames from a video generated by a baseline model or VideoGen-Agent. Baselines often capture the red visual effects and attack motion but fail to reproduce the named character’s appearance. Using retrieved visual references, VideoGen-Agent better preserves Camellya’s distinguishing features and outfit while depicting the requested action.

blocks.en: Figure 5 : Qualitative comparison on Multi-Entity Identity generation. The prompt depicts three Dota 2 characters performing their signature attacks together: Muerta fires skull bullets, Grimstroke casts ink, and Oracle summons golden energy. Each row shows six uniformly sampled frames from a video generated by a baseline model or VideoGen-Agent. Baselines depict parts of the requested effects but struggle to preserve all three identities and their corresponding actions together. By supplying retrieved references for each character, VideoGen-Agent better preserves their distinct appearances and depicts their attacks within the same scene.
blocks.zh: 图5:多实体身份生成的质量比较。 即时画面描绘了三个Dota 2人物一起进行签名攻击:Muerta火头骨子弹,Grimstroke铸墨,以及甲骨文召唤金能量. 每行显示基线模型或VideoGen-Agent生成的视频中六个统一取样的帧. 基线描绘了所要求的部分效果,但努力保留所有三种特征,并共同采取相应行动。 VideoGen-Agent通过为每个角色提供检索到的参考文献,更好地保存了他们独特的外表,并描述了他们在同一场景中的攻击.

blocks.en: Figure 6 : Qualitative comparison on Physics Simulation generation. The prompt specifies a 0.3 ​ kg 0.3\,\mathrm{kg} rubber ball moving at 8 ​ m / s 8\,\mathrm{m/s} that strikes the edge of a 3 ​ kg 3\,\mathrm{kg} metal cube, inducing rotation. Each row shows six uniformly sampled frames from a video generated by a baseline model or VideoGen-Agent. Baselines show inconsistent contact or post-impact motion, including implausible rebounds and cube responses. VideoGen-Agent uses code-based simulation to compute the interaction and supplies the resulting optical-flow sequence to Wan-VACE-14B for motion-conditioned generation. The generated sequence more faithfully depicts the ball’s rebound and the cube’s translation and rotation following the impact.

blocks.en: Figure 7 : Qualitative comparison on Compositional Scene generation. The prompt describes an outdoor wedding where a ring bearer drops a pillow and two rings bounce toward a garden fountain. A flower girl dives for one ring, while the groom’s dog snatches the other. Each row shows six uniformly sampled frames from a video generated by a baseline model or VideoGen-Agent. Baselines reproduce parts of the wedding scene but omit required subjects or fail to connect their actions in the requested sequence. Detection feedback guides prompt revision and regeneration in VideoGen-Agent, helping it depict the required subjects and the progression from the dropped pillow to both responses.

blocks.en: Figure 8 : Qualitative comparison on Multi-Shot generation. The prompt specifies a 12-second sequence in which a leaf-clogged gutter overflows, its bracket cracks, and the gutter swings down. Each row shows six uniformly sampled frames from a video generated by a baseline model or VideoGen-Agent. Baselines often omit intermediate phases or fail to depict their ordered progression. VideoGen-Agent generates the phases separately, conditions each subsequent segment on the previous segment’s final frame, and concatenates them in the requested order.

blocks.en: We sample 100 100 video pairs per category ( 600 600 pairs in total), balanced across the strongest standalone baseline, VideoGen-Agent-SFT, and VideoGen-Agent-RL. Three human raters independently compare each pair without knowing which models generated the videos. They assess the category-specific requirements, including procedural accuracy for Procedural Knowledge, identity preservation for Single-Entity Identity and Multi-Entity Identity, and physical plausibility for Physics Simulation. For Compositional Scene and Multi-Shot, they assess subject interactions and temporal phase structure, respectively. Overall prompt faithfulness serves as the tie-breaker.
